name: Yonex Co., Ltd.
verdict: Yonex Co., Ltd., a Tokyo-listed sporting-goods maker whose largest shareholder is its own sports foundation. Nothing found.
note: Uniform supplier of Kashiwa Reysol 2026-27 per https://www.reysol.co.jp/news/goods/202627-4.html (【ユニフォームサプライヤー】ヨネックス株式会社). Rating note: the largest holders are the Yonex sports foundation (11.06%), NATIONAL FINANCIAL SERVICES LLC (6.77%), individuals named 米山 (Yoneyama) and a second Yoneyama foundation (4.66%); governments and local public bodies hold no shares. Quick company check (2026-09-30): no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against Yonex found.
